title: Van Dijk 2018-19 v Ferdinand 2007-08: the best defender season?
checked: Van Dijk joined Liverpool on 1 January 2018 for a reported £75m, a world record for a defender (BBC, Wikipedia). 2018-19: 97 points, one league defeat, 22 conceded, City 98 (Wikipedia PL, Wikipedia season). Barcelona 3-0 Liverpool 1 May 2019, Liverpool 4-0 Barcelona 7 May 2019 without Salah and Firmino (Wikipedia season, UEFA). Final 1 June 2019 Madrid, Spurs 0-2, Origi's 87th-minute goal from Matip (Wikipedia final, UEFA). Ballon d'Or 2019 Messi 686, Van Dijk 679, Ronaldo 476 (Wikipedia, ballondor.com). 2007-08: United 87, Chelsea 85, 22 conceded (Wikipedia). Moscow final 21 May 2008 1-1, 6-5 on penalties, Terry slipped and hit the post, Van der Sar saved Anelka (Wikipedia final, Al Jazeera, Man United). Gameplay: Origi's goal and Van der Sar's save recreated with gamecap (specs origi-2019, rio-2008).

lines.text: A defender came seven points from the Ballon d'Or. Another won everything that mattered. Van Dijk, or Rio?
lines.say: A defender came seven points from the Balon Dor. Another won everything that mattered. Van Dyke, or Reeoh?

lines.text: January 2018. Liverpool pay seventy-five million pounds for Virgil van Dijk. A world record for a defender.

scene.headline: Liverpool sign Van Dijk for world-record fee
scene.standfirst: The Dutch centre-back joins from Southampton for a reported £75m, the most ever paid for a defender.

lines.say: January, twenty eighteen. Liverpool pay seventy five million pounds for Virgil van Dijk. A world record for a defender.

lines.text: In 2018-19, Liverpool lose one league game, and still finish second. City get ninety-eight.
lines.say: In twenty eighteen, nineteen, Liverpool lose one league game, and still finish second. City get ninety eight.

lines.text: In Europe, they lose three-nil at the Nou Camp. Dead and buried.
lines.say: In Europe, they lose three nil at the Noo Camp. Dead and buried.

lines.text: Then Anfield. No Salah, no Firmino. Four-nil.
lines.say: Then Anfield. No Sahlah, no Firmeeno. Four-nil.

lines.text: In the final, Spurs. Origi seals it. Two-nil. Champions of Europe.
lines.say: In the final, Spurs. Oreegee seals it. Two-nil. Champions of Europe.

lines.text: December. Messi six hundred and eighty-six. Van Dijk six hundred and seventy-nine. Seven points.
lines.say: December. Messi six hundred and eighty-six. Van Dyke six hundred and seventy-nine. Seven points.

lines.text: Now Rio Ferdinand, 2007-08. United concede twenty-two league goals, and win the title by two points.
lines.say: Now Reeoh Ferdinand, twenty oh seven, oh eight. United concede twenty two league goals, and win the title by two points.

lines.text: Then the first all-English Champions League final. Moscow, in the rain. One-one.
lines.say: Then the first all-English Champions League final. Moscow, in the rain. One-one.

lines.text: Penalties. John Terry steps up to win it for Chelsea. He slips, and hits the post.
lines.say: Penalties. John Terry steps up to win it for Chelsea. He slips, and hits the post.

lines.text: Sudden death. Van der Sar saves from Anelka. United win six-five.
lines.say: Sudden death. Van der Sar saves from Anelka. United win six-five.

lines.text: Both defences let in twenty-two. Rio has more medals. Van Dijk has the bigger season.
lines.say: Both defences let in twenty-two. Reeoh has more medals. Van Dyke has the bigger season.

lines.text: A defender, seven points from the Ballon d'Or. Settled: Van Dijk.
lines.say: A defender, seven points from the Balon Dor. Settled: Van Dyke.

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
